pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:187 The DPS read-outs come from one synchronous reduction over a static authored weapon table, with no model, validation set, batch loop or process sharding; a case-insensitive search of sub_combat/_shared and sub_combat/metrics for mean_over_batch, all_reduce, nanmean, world_size, .detach(, buffer, accumulat and reduction found nothing, so the subject's precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:187 The whole finite table is evaluated in one call at module load, with no per-batch append or aggregate seam; the technique says a set evaluated in one call needs no buffer.
